shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books every night.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I often go hiking in the mountains near my home.
Cooking new recipes helps me relax after a long day.
I like to listen to music while I work on projects.
Traveling to new places really broadens my perspective.
I often volunteer at the local animal shelter on weekends.
Watching documentaries gives me a better understanding of the world.
Practicing a new language can be challenging but rewarding.
Gardening in my backyard has taught me patience and care.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What challenges did you face during your travels?
Q3: In your opinion, what is the value of traveling?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about sports habits.
questions: Q1: What sports do you enjoy playing or watching?
Q2: How do you find the time to stay active?
Q3: Why do you think sports are important in our lives?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone starting a new sport?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about music preferences.
questions: Q1: What type of music do you enjoy the most?
Q2: How has your taste in music changed over the years?
Q3: Why do you believe music is significant to people?
Q4: What tips can you give someone looking to explore new genres?
